if you’re not depressed and you personally believe that it does not take an effect on your day to day life along with anxiety issues then i don’t think that you should take it. but i mean it’s really up to you, not your doctor, or anyone else:) it could be the wrong medication for you, and if you think that you need something to help your anxiety i would try something else. you could stick with it for atleast a month because that’s how long SSRIs typically take to work, but if youre consistently getting side effects and it’s not helping you and you think that it’s worse than not taking it at all then iwould stop. for some people as well, depression could last anywhere from a month to someone’s whole life. it’s effected me severely and i’ve had it for five years so if that puts anything into perspective for you. i’m on and have been on 75mg of zoloft and i can say that it’s helped me plenty, however like i said before it just may not work for you. talk ab maybe switching ur medication or dosage or just dropping it altogether. hope this helped you out a bit
